description: Primary-source conference championship documents (event order and relay list). Every entry in packages/core/src/data/relayPrograms.ts traces to one of these by sourceId + sha256; the NSISC entry confirms the event order of the engine session schedule nsisc-table-c (no code cites it). Hand-maintained: no fetch script yet. Same fields as data/cutlines/sources/manifest.json.

sources.linkedFrom: https://glvcsports.com/2026swim, link text "Complete Results", href /documents/2026/2/14//Complete_Results.pdf?id=5359. That glvcsports.com page is an HTML viewer that embeds the url above in an <object> tag.
sources.note: A results document, not a pre-meet program. It prints each numbered event in the order the meet ran it. The 2027 championship (2027-02-09 to 2027-02-13, Evansville) has no published program on record.

sources.linkedFrom: Web search result titled "2026 NSISC Championships Final Results", on Ouachita Baptist University athletics (obu.sidearmsports.com) document storage. User decision R94 (2026-11-05) approved the download.
sources.note: HY-TEK Meet Manager 7.0 results, printed 2026-02-21. Scored events 1 to 42 run in the order of Table C (plans/2026-10-25/00-USER-PLAN.md lines 55-76), which packages/engine/src/planner/builtins.ts nsisc-table-c v1 copies. No 100 Yard IM was swum (0 occurrences). Events 100 to 939 are time trials and exhibition swims, not championship events. The document prints no session times, so it does not settle the small-field 1650 session (R94: stays pending).
